s0CA146.name: Draw banner; dispatch scene substate
summary: Tail of a sprite-banner drawer: draws 16 16x16 OAM sprites (tiles DATA_0CA136, property $35) as two 4x2-tile halves,
the first at X = $80, the second at X = $40 - [$04] (probably the end-of-credits title graphic). Skips tiles whose X high byte is non-zero.
$0CA1D4 (entry): runs CODE_0CAB1F (fade/window and scene timer update) and jumps through the substate table at $0CA1DE by [$1442].

PtrsLong0CA1DE.name: Scene substate table and substate 0
summary: Pointer table (long) of credits-scene substates indexed by [$1442], followed by substate 0.
Substate 0: after the fade-in ([$1B89] = 0) sets Mario Y = $0160, walks Mario left (actor 0, X speed $F8) with Yoshi (sprite $35)
following $30 pixels behind, moves the line of seven actors (7-13) left, bounces them, and draws everything.
Advances to substate 1 when actor 7 reaches X = $0030. Actor arrays: Y speed $0B05, Y pos $0B41, X speed $0B14, X pos $0B50 (hi $0B6E).

s0CA315.name: Update hopping character and draw trio
summary: Gravity-hops actor 1 (Y speed += 1, floor at Y = $9F, bounce speed $F0), derives pose [$1458] (0-2) from its vertical speed,
and, if [$1457] = 1, draws three characters (left X=$18, right X=$D4, centre X=$50) with frames chosen by the pose.

s0CA3B4.name: Data: initial line actor X, Y, speed

s0CA3C9.name: Initialise credits scene actors
summary: Called by JSL. Resets scene state ([$1442], pose, timers $1B89/$1928 = $E2), puts actor 0 (Mario) at X = $0100, actor 1 at Y = $9F,
starts music $0A and sets up the seven line actors 7-13 from the tables above (X high byte 1, gravity 1).

s0CA43C.name: Substate 1: landing pose animation
summary: While pose [$1458] < 8 runs the hopping routine; when the hop ends on pose 0 at the ground it starts pose 8. Poses 8-$0A step every 6 frames;
reaching $0B holds $0A and moves to substate 2. Draws the left/right/centre characters per pose, then joins the substate 0 drawing at $0CA1F6.

s0CA524.name: Data: release bit masks and order

s0CA532.name: Substate 2: release the seven actors
summary: One actor per call ([$145C] = 0): launches line actor 7+X upward (speed $C0, gravity 4), spawns four particle actors 3-6 at its position,
sets its bit in the visible mask [$145A], plays sound $0A. After the 8th ([$145B]) sets actor 2 X = $80, changes music to $0B and goes to substate 3.
Otherwise runs CODE_0CA5DE (outside this chunk) and redraws via $0CA4B6.
